recentItems.title: Radio Citizen hosts the Utepeni program in Kisii
recentItems.description:
Hundreds of radio citizen fans in Kisii thronged the Kisii Agricultural Training Centre, to engage county government leaders on various issues affecting them. 
The county government, led by Governor Simba Arati, together with the county security team, responded to a range of issues raised by residents during the live Utepeni programme, hosted by Radio Citizen presenters Christine Ojiambo and Fred Ngetich. The elated fans and residents lauded the programme for giving them a rare opportunity to interact directly with their county leadership. For many, the engagement provided a platform to raise concerns with those entrusted with running county affairs.

recentItems.title: Opposition leaders condemn alleged targeting of MP Mukunji over Embu chaos
recentItems.description: The united opposition, led by Kalonzo Musyoka, has faulted the government over heavy security at All Saints Cathedral, where the Linda Mwananchi team is worshipping, accusing the state of using security agencies to intimidate and silence the opposition ahead of next year's election. Speaking in Hola, Tana River, the opposition has also defended Manyatta MP John Mukunji over claims he was behind the chaos witnessed at Deputy President Kithure Kindiki’s rally in Embu, accusing the government of allowing political goonism and chaos to thrive.

recentItems.description: The fifth edition of the American Golf Day was held at the prestigious Muthaiga Golf Club, bringing together golfers from across the country for a vibrant celebration of Meru culture, community and sport.
